criterion: The product opens onto the cycle board as its main working surface.
evaluation_rule: Yes if the first signed-in surface is the cycle board. No if it opens onto something else.

criterion: Another team's issues stay absent from the board and every signed-in surface.
evaluation_rule: Yes if only the member's own team data is shown. No if any other team's issue is visible.

criterion: A fixed left sidebar sits beside the board carrying team and cycle navigation.
evaluation_rule: Yes if a persistent left sidebar holds the navigation. No if the sidebar is absent.

criterion: A signed-in member landing shows the cycle board rather than a blank page.
evaluation_rule: Yes if a signed-in landing shows the board. No if the landing is blank or errors.

criterion: The board arranges the active cycle across five workflow-state columns.
evaluation_rule: Yes if five workflow-state columns are shown. No if the columns are missing or merged.

criterion: A refused move rolls back on the board and shows a message.
evaluation_rule: Yes if a refused move returns the card and shows a reason. No if the card stays moved or fails silently.

criterion: A signed-out visit to a protected route lands on the login page.
evaluation_rule: Yes if a signed-out visit redirects to the login page. No if the protected route opens without a session.

criterion: Each workflow-state column on the board carries its own distinct glyph.
evaluation_rule: Yes if each state shows its own glyph. No if states are told apart by colour alone.

criterion: The single accent colour marks the primary action on a board card and appears on nothing else.
evaluation_rule: Yes if the accent is reserved for the primary action. No if the accent is spread across other elements.

criterion: The board and its panels read as a dark surface with quiet, layered panels separated by hairlines.
evaluation_rule: Yes if panels sit on a dark ground separated by hairlines. No if the surface is light or panels use bold colour steps.

criterion: Issue keys on a board card render in a monospace family with aligned figures.
evaluation_rule: Yes if identifiers use a monospace family. No if they use the proportional interface family.

criterion: A board card shows the issue key beside its title.
evaluation_rule: Yes if a card shows both the key and the title. No if either is absent from the card.

criterion: Larger board rearrangements ease in and settle rather than snapping.
evaluation_rule: Yes if larger transitions are eased. No if they snap or jump abruptly.

criterion: Body text on the board holds a WCAG AA contrast ratio against the dark surface.
evaluation_rule: Yes if body text meets the AA contrast bar. No if body text falls below it.

criterion: At a narrow viewport the board reflows and its columns stay within the screen width.
evaluation_rule: Yes if the board fits the narrow viewport width. No if content overflows sideways.
